how_to_apply: Deposit the application fee through RTGS, NEFT, or net banking into the specified IIT SRIC-OM Account.
Note down the transaction details such as UTR No. or Transaction ID.
Visit the official online application portal of IIT Kharagpur Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy.
Fill out the online application form with all required personal, educational, and professional details.
Enter the bank transaction details into the application form.
Review the filled application form carefully and submit it on or before 22 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: IIT Kharagpur has announced recruitment for 1 Project Assistant [PA] - Research post under advertisement number IIT/SRIC/C/SNPF/2026/101.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Assistant [PA] - Research position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 22 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree or have 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech with at least one research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the last date of the advertisement, with age relaxation as per sponsor agency rules if applicable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is 0 for all categories including General, OBC, SC, ST, and Female candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to 30000 per month depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the tenure of the project?
faq.answer: The tenure is 12 months or until the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.
